sources.games: 530 league games since 7.41 (data/heroes/item_stats), win 55.3%. Reproduce: python scripts/hero_item_stats.py monkey_king.
sources.items: Valve /datafeed/itemdata, 7.41f: Monkey King Bar, Silver Edge, Maelstrom, Mjollnir, Battle Fury.
sources.player: Player review, 2026-10-19: no Maelstrom against illusions, maybe Battle Fury (a note). Eye of Skadi against heavy healing (it is in the build).

rules.name: Monkey King Bar

reason.en: {enemy} dodges attacks: with {item} most of your attacks go through the evasion
reason.uk: {enemy} ухиляється від атак: з {item} більшість ваших атак пробиває ухилення

rules.basis: Monkey King Bar pierces evasion on 80% of attacks, nothing to cast. High-rank Monkey King players against Phantom Assassin or Windranger: 33% of 39 games against them (9% otherwise), won 77% against 46%.

rules.name: Silver Edge

reason.en: {enemy} relies on {spell}: the hit out of the invisibility of {item} turns it off for 5 seconds
reason.uk: {enemy} тримається на здатності {spell}: удар із невидимості {item} вимикає її на 5 секунд

rules.basis: Valve 7.41f: Shadow Walk, the attack that ends the invisibility disables the target's passive abilities for 5 s, +300 physical damage and caps its movement speed at 200. High-rank Monkey King players against Bristleback, Spectre or Huskar: 31% of 68 games against them (7% otherwise), won 67% against 45%.

rules.name: Eye of Skadi

reason.en: {enemy} heals a lot: your {item} halves their health restoration, so keep it in the build
reason.uk: {enemy} багато лікується: ваш {item} удвічі ріже відновлення здоров'я, тож не пропускайте його

rules.basis: Valve 7.41f Eye of Skadi: attacks cut health restoration by 50% for 3 s (+35 all attributes, the slow). It is in the build (32% of the won games, ~33 min); high-rank Monkey Kings against heavy healers: not among the 12 items bought more often in 76 games against them. The player review: Skadi against healing for every carry who has it in the build.

build_basis: Assembled items bought in 25%+ of the won games, by median minute: wraith_band 42% (2), magic_wand 87% (4), power_treads 94% (6), pers 36% (10), mage_slayer 20% (13), echo_sabre 57% (13), desolator 71% (18), great_famango 22% (21), yasha 28% (21), black_king_bar 68% (25), harpoon 42% (27), aghanims_shard 58% (27), skadi 32% (33), butterfly 22% (38).

tempo.basis: Gold lines where the hero wins 85.0%+: 20:00 11000 (75 games, 85.3%), 25:00 15000 (74 games, 86.5%), 30:00 18500 (85 games, 87.1%); net worth ~0.96 of that gold.

reason.en: Your net worth is {net_worth}, well ahead for this minute: {item} on the tempo build comes before the counters, then take the Aegis and push for the throne
reason.uk: Ваш нетворс — {net_worth}, набагато більше звичайного для цієї хвилини: спершу {item} з темпової збірки, потім заберіть Aegis і йдіть на трон

suppress.illusions: Wukong's Command soldiers (Valve 7.41f: 14 s, they attack heroes only) and Jingu Mastery carry his fights. High-rank Monkey Kings against illusion heroes: Maelstrom 17% of 47 games against them (5% otherwise), won 25% against 56%; Mjollnir 15% of 47 games against them (4% otherwise), won 14% against 58%, so it is not advised for him.

skills.basis: 530 games: maxed monkey_king_tree_dance > monkey_king_boundless_strike > monkey_king_jingu_mastery 291 (win 56.4%), monkey_king_jingu_mastery > monkey_king_boundless_strike > monkey_king_tree_dance 102 (win 52.9%), monkey_king_tree_dance > monkey_king_jingu_mastery > monkey_king_boundless_strike 66 (win 50.0%); talents 10: Tree Dance Cast Range 435/529 (56.3%), Boundless Strike Stun Duration 94/529 (51.1%); 15: Jingu Mastery Damage 488/500 (57.2%), 0 Cooldown Primal Spring 12/500 (50.0%); 20: Boundless Strike Critical Damage 338/366 (62.7%), Jingu Mastery Undispellable 28/366 (67.9%); 25: Additional Wukong's Command Ring 170/177 (66.5%), Jingu Mastery Required Hits 7/177 (57.1%).

reason.en: {enemy} fights with illusions: if they are hard to kill, Battle Fury is an option, its cleave hits the illusions around your target
reason.uk: {enemy} б'ється ілюзіями: якщо їх важко вбити, можна взяти Battle Fury — його розщеплення б'є ілюзії навколо вашої цілі

notes.basis: Valve 7.41f Battle Fury, Cleave (melee): 60% of the attack damage in a 650 cone around the target. High-rank Monkey Kings against illusion heroes: 17% of 47 games against them (13% otherwise), won 38% against 54%, so a note, not the next item. The player review: maybe Battle Fury.
